summary: {director} lays the course maintenance schedule beside the proposed fee receipts.
realLife: Portland asked parks staff to identify major maintenance needs over the next decade when reporting on the golf fund and its fees.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: a dated maintenance estimate and receipts at each proposed fee level.

turns.pulledBy: The increase would cover only the first repair.
turns.what: The director identifies which work could proceed.
turns.writesBack: The capital forecast leaves the later jobs outstanding.

turns.pulledBy: The council reduces prices but wants the same work done.
turns.what: The director prices the missing contribution.
